BiblicalUsage: A structure is the word for a building, and it appears once, in Ezekiel's measuring of the temple. In Ezekiel 41:13 he measured the house, an hundred cubits long, and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long. A measured building, in a measured house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the measuring matters: God counts the cubits of his house, and nothing about it is careless.
